items.claim: Ian Garry is a tall fighter with great jiu-jitsu and striking.
items.quote: Ian's a tall guy, he's got great jiu-jitsu, he's got great striking.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is currently unstoppable in his division.
items.quote: I don't see anybody who can stop him right now in this division.

items.claim: Ian Garry is talented and skillful enough to surprise people in the fight.
items.quote: I think Ian is going to surprise a lot of people with how talented he is and how skillful he is.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is bigger, stronger, has more power, and will take Ian Garry down to hold and submit him.
items.quote: Makhachev is bigger and he's he he stronger and like he got more power and he can he going to take him down and hold him and submit him

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is too dominant, leaving Ian Garry with few options to win.
items.quote: He's just so dominant. I I don't see Ian having a lot of options to winning that one.

items.claim: Ian Garry's only loss came against a tough grappler in Shavkat.
items.quote: one of the only loss that Ian Garry has has been against a real tough grappler when he fought Shavkat.

items.claim: Ian Garry has a striking and reach advantage going into the fight against Islam Makhachev.
items.quote: Ian Garry may have an advantage in the striking um in the rage department going against the going into this fight against Islam.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev does very well in the pocket and can close distance effectively.
items.quote: Islam does very good in the pocket, does very good he's able to close distance

items.claim: Ian Garry is very good at fighting on the outside and avoiding opponents in close distance.
items.quote: Ian Garry is very um good at being able to fight on the outside and avoid his uh opponents on the close distance on him.

items.claim: Ian Garry can frustrate Islam Makhachev and catch him if he maintains distance.
items.quote: If he can maintain that distance against Islam, um I think he can kind of frustrate him and really catch him in the in the fight as well

items.claim: Ian Garry fights very well, smartly, and impressively.
items.quote: I think Ian Garry just like fights so well, so smart, and he's very impressive

items.claim: Ian Garry keeps his distance very well and is dangerous on the feet.
items.quote: he keeps his distance so well. He did I think Ian Garry is such a smart fighter and uh and uh just fights so well that I think he could pull it off, man. I think he can keep distance. I think he's so dangerous on the feet still

items.claim: Islam Makhachev will likely wrestle Ian Garry to a decision.
items.quote: I would bet my money on Islam um wrestling him to a decision.
